content.comment_body: When using a weekly timer and setting days via the [product_name] display in simulation mode, the field for Sunday is missing; only Monday through Saturday are shown. This occurs only in simulation mode, not on actual hardware or in the web interface. The issue is present in [product_name] V8.3, while earlier V8.0x, V8.1x, and other V8.x versions don't have this bug.
That's strange. I tested a new project in V8.3 and all seven days are displayed in the simulator.
Your screenshot doesn't show what happens when you try to set the days via the display.

Today, I created a new [product_name] project with two blocks, pressed F3, and checked Sunday as the last weekday. I was able to check all seven days in the [product_name] V8.3 simulator, using the V8.3 project version. I used the parameter 'Wochentag1' twice to test its position, but encountered no issues. You might want to upload your test program here.
See the attached file and a screen recording showing the issue.
Here is a screenshot from another forum post.

Thank you for sharing the program. I tried it in the simulator, and all seven days are visible and can be changed as expected. However, in your video, when you attempt to change a day, only six days can be selected. Aside from that, everything is identical to my experience, and all seven days appear before you start editing. I'm using Windows 10 with default character settings and 100% zoom. Perhaps your PC has a different character set or zoom level?

I'd appreciate seeing a screenshot where all seven weekdays are editable with proper Windows 10 settings. My [product_name] V8.3 also displays only six weekdays with 100% zoom and default character settings. There may be a workaround, but adjusting these settings hasn't helped. Regards, [user_name]

I edited in the simulator using the attached screenshot edit_days.png and the test program from [user_name]. Since I'm not a Windows expert, I can only suggest changing resolution, zoom, or character set in Windows 10, but I'm unsure how. I never alter my Windows settings. Using a standard 1920x1200 monitor, I don't need zoom. I've included a screenshot showing Windows settings with zoom (Win10.png).

This issue isn't a high priority for me since it happens only in simulation mode. I doubt it's Windows-related; it's likely a bug in [product_name] V8.3. When I run [product_name] V8.2 with the same setup on the same PC, I see different results, as shown in my screenshot. Are there startup parameters for [product_name] that might produce varied results? I couldn't find any information in the manual. Regards, [user_name]

After further testing, I can reproduce the issue and found a workaround: In [product_name] Soft Comfort, go to menu 'Tools > Options > Scale' and set scaling to 125% or 150%. As a tip, I changed it to 125% some time ago for another reason. Setting scale to 100% reproduces the problem, but at 125% it works. I will inform the development team.
Conclusion: There is a bug in [product_name] V8.3!

analysis.insight_summary: Users identified that in the simulation of [product_name] V8.3, configuring weekdays via the display sometimes omits Sunday, with only Monday to Saturday available. The issue is exclusive to the simulation environment and does not occur on actual devices or webserver. Some users see all seven days, while others consistently reproduce the missing Sunday, indicating it's an environment-related but repeatable issue. This leads to confusion and concerns about reliability when using software simulation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all seven weekdays to be selectable in simulation mode, matching the functionality of actual hardware and previous software versions.
